mines.mine_notes: Underground silver mine (Proaño), operating since 1554; includes pyrite plant: primary circuit 10,273 koz Ag + 40,753 oz Au, pyrite concentrate adds 1,569 koz Ag + 2,289 oz Au. Zinc 44,721 t. Cash cost and AISC per oz of silver. 2,099 kt ore milled.
mines.processing: Flotation + cyanidation leaching; pyrite concentrate processed at Saucito pyrite plant

mines.mine_notes: Underground silver mine in the Fresnillo District; primary circuit 13,791 koz Ag + 69,388 oz Au, pyrite plant adds 515 koz Ag + 1,459 oz Au (incl. Juanicipio pyrite processed here). Zinc 40,307 t. Cash cost and AISC per oz of silver. 2,278 kt ore milled.

Underground silver mine in the Fresnillo District; JV — Fresnillo plc holds 56%, Pan American Silver 44%. Figures are attributable to Fresnillo (56%). Primary circuit 9,643 koz Ag + 23,854 oz Au; pyrite adds 212 koz Ag + 348 oz Au. Zinc 20,359 t. Cash cost and AISC per oz of silver. 768.7 kt ore processed (attributable).
Underground silver-gold mine (San Julián district); disseminated ore body (DOB) mining ceased — veins only from 2025. 1,261 kt ore milled. Cash cost and AISC per oz of silver.

Underground gold-silver mine (Durango), operating since 1992; evolving towards narrow high-grade gold areas; zinc concentrate production discontinued in 2025. 900 kt ore milled. Cash cost and AISC per oz of gold. Lead 948 t, zinc 527 t.

Open pit gold mine (Sonora); heap leach (20.0 Mt ore deposited) + dynamic leaching plants; 95.6 Mt total volume hauled. Cash cost and AISC per oz of gold. Valles underground project on track for 1H27 startup.
mines.processing: Heap leach + dynamic leaching plants; sulphides crushing circuit and ADR plant under construction (1Q26)

mines.mine_notes: Open pit gold mine (Sonora); mining ended May 2023 — 2025 output is residual leaching of pads (gold content in pads revised +20.7 koz Jan 1, 2025). Mine closure plan in progress. No reserves remaining.
Open pit gold mine (Sonora); operations suspended since 2013 (lost access to leaching pads due to land dispute); excluded from 2025 production and reserves; excluded from mine count.

notes: World's largest primary silver producer; also listed on the Mexican Stock Exchange (BMV). FY2025 attributable production: silver 48.7 moz (47.6 moz own mines + 1.1 moz Silverstream) and gold 600.3 koz. Mine production figures reconcile to attributable totals incl. pyrite concentrates processed at Saucito (Saucito: 515 koz Ag/1,459 oz Au; Fresnillo mine: 1,569 koz Ag/2,289 oz Au; Juanicipio: 212 koz Ag/348 oz Au). Silverstream derivative terminated Aug 2025 via US$40M buyback with Peñoles. Lead 62,076 t; zinc 105,915 t. Group EBITDA US$2,966.7M; revenues US$4,561.2M; cash costs/AISC quoted in USD per oz. Audited reserves as at 30 April 2025 (SRK/AMC): gold 7.8 moz, silver 362.6 moz attributable. Advanced exploration: Orisyvo, Rodeo, Guanajuato, Tajitos; Probe Gold (Canada, Novador ~10 Moz resource) acquired Jan 2026.
